title: Egg Dosa
description: A Tamil street-style dosa topped with beaten egg, pepper and onion, folded over for a protein rich breakfast.
steps: Beat the 2 eggs in a bowl with the onion, green chilli, coriander leaves, salt and black pepper powder.
Heat a tawa over medium heat and brush with a little of the oil.
Pour a ladle of the dosa batter and spread it into a round that is slightly thicker than usual.
Pour a quarter of the egg mixture over the dosa and spread it evenly with the back of the spoon.
Drizzle a little oil around the edges and cook for 2 minutes until the egg is set.
Fold or flip as you prefer, cook another minute, and repeat for the remaining batter; serve hot with chutney.
